problems: The record lists two separate placebo interventions (Placebo - 50 mg, Placebo - 100 mg), which suggests four randomised arms (two placebo-to-active sequences). An even four-way split of 200 would give 50 on ritlecitinib 100 mg and 100 on pooled placebo, not 67/67. The card's notes already flag this.

The record only says 'change from baseline in UACR'. The card turns this into a difference in mean percent change (percentage points), but UACR results are usually reported as a ratio of geometric means (placebo-adjusted % change), which is not the same number as a percentage-point difference. The card's notes explain the choice.
